function: Joint learning of spatial-frequency user scheduling, hybrid precoding, and analog combining to maximize sum spectral efficiency in downlink wideband MU-MIMO (p. 4-5).
system: Downlink MU-MIMO OFDM, hybrid precoding: base station 8-128 antennas, 2-12 RF chains; users 1-8 antennas; 28 GHz, 400 MHz; no RIS (p. 4, p. 11).
method: Unsupervised learning (negative sum-rate loss) of cascaded scheduler and precoder graph neural networks (3D-GNN, sequence of GNNs, partial attention), pre-trained then jointly fine-tuned (p. 4, p. 6-10).
data_channel: Simulated 3GPP TR 38.901 UMa non-line-of-sight channels (reference [35]); CDL-A for the crowded-user scenario; 200,000 training and 2,000 test samples (p. 11-12).
test_conditions: Size generalization without retraining: trained at 16 RBs, 30 users, 16 BS antennas, 4 user antennas, tested on 4-128, 3-60, 8-128, 1-8 respectively (p. 13).
baselines: Non-learned: LISA, Greedy, SDR, SVD, EIG, MO, OMP, LISA-SDR. Learned: GAT, CNN, FNN as scheduler and precoder modules (p. 12).
metrics: Spectral efficiency, SE ratio to LISA-SDR, inference runtime in ms, trainable weights, training samples, training time in hours (p. 12-14).
complexity: FLOPs orders (Table II, p. 11); inference 81-179 ms versus 8927-9205 ms for LISA-SDR, 633k-662k weights (Table IV, p. 13); training samples and hours (Table V, p. 14).
q1_support: p. 11: "Consider a non-line-of-sight channel model in urban macro (UMa) scenario [35]"; [35] is 3GPP TR 38.901 (p. 15). p. 12: "clustered delay line-A model [35]" for the crowded-user scenario.
q2_support: p. 13: "trained with samples of 16 RBs and tested with samples of 4 to 128 RBs without retraining"; likewise 30 users to 3-60, 16 BS antennas to 8-128, NR = 4 to 1-8 (Figs. 10-12).
q3_support: p. 12: "The superior performance of NGNN and SGNN is evident from the enlarged gaps with other learning methods as SNR increases" (GAT, CNN, FNN); they also outperform LISA, SVD and approach SDR, all on spectral efficiency.
q4_support: p. 10: "The computational complexity for inference is measured in floating point operations (FLOPs)"; p. 11: Table II gives FLOPs orders; p. 13: Table IV gives runtime 81 to 179 ms versus 8927 to 9205 ms for LISA-SDR, and 633k to 662k weights.
q5_support: p. 1: "The source code is available at https://github.com/LSJ-BUAA/GNNScheduling-Precoding."
notes: Area 3: hybrid precoding and analog combining learned jointly with user scheduling (scheduling alone is above the PHY, but a PHY decision is learned jointly). PDF is the arXiv v2 preprint (2503.04233v2, 24 Jul 2025); the DOI is not printed in the file, so identity rests on the title. q1 rests on the UMa non-line-of-sight and CDL-A channels cited to 3GPP TR 38.901 as [35]; reviewer to confirm. Each of Figs. 9-12 varies one size at a time.
